attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Connecticut state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Conn. Gen. Stat. § 12-700: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 6.99%. Standard deductions: $0 Single/MFS, $24,000 MFJ/QSS, $19,000 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Connecticut Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.99%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

Filing status is Head of Household
